meta.title: Tile Layout
meta.description: Open a dedicated panel from the sidebar. Choose sessions there or use the icon in a session header. Drag to reorder and resize, or scroll horizontally on desktop. Swipe between sessions on mobile. Each tile uses the full native conversation page, including its header, menus, plugins and right sidebar.
